purpose: Normal/Hard M01–M07 overlays derive from the corresponding Easy candidate encounter without copying maps, routes or mission objectives.

inheritance.stageMap: inherit-exactly (board size, tile geography, obstacles, starting allied cells, mission structure cells)
inheritance.winAndLoss: inherit-exactly (type, target amount, main timer, victory/loss events)
inheritance.subobjective: inherit-exactly, including percentage threshold when maxHP changes
inheritance.campaignRewards: inherit missions.json by difficulty; never inherit Easy reward amounts
inheritance.playerSetup: no forced loadout, no artificial CAP change, no level gate: recommended levels are advisory
inheritance.baselineEnemyProfiles: derive from each Easy mission candidate and M01 enemy archetype definitions
inheritance.profileScaling: apply numeric multipliers exactly once at initial spawn; avoid stacking upon respawn
inheritance.baseEnemyMovement: unchanged MOV and attack ranges; no invented geometry
inheritance.normalDifficultyExceptionPolicy: only explicit mission overlay fields may add units
inheritance.specialBossSkillPolicy: only explicit hard boss mission's skill; do not give all Hard enemies additional moves/attacks automatically
inheritance.structureScaling: where enabled, reference a mission-specific HP/DEF overlay; no objective percentage alteration

enemyScaling.method: compute base-stat-derived encounter profile once on stage load
enemyScaling.rounding: round-half-up for nonnegative values: Math.floor(base * multiplier + 0.5)
rationale: At the same map, enemy kill time is increased mainly by maxHP and DEF, incoming threat by attack stat + weaponPower.
MOV and range do not increase automatically because narrow/timed objectives can otherwise become unreachable.
Normal requires stronger prioritization without hidden aim bonuses; Hard adds legal-move planning rather than unfair information access.
Initial coefficients are balance candidates, not inferred from any completed simulation.

aiQuality.easyReference: per-mission Easy candidate AI is the baseline

normal.approach: rank each legal move+one action combination via immediate value
normal.coordinateAllies: share deterministic public threat evaluations, but no scripted forced focus fire
normal.retreatWhenUseful: may reposition to a better legal shot; never deliberately skip an available tactically useful action

hard.approach: bounded tactical lookahead, then execute one legal move and one legal action
hard.planningHorizon: current action plus estimate of next player threat/opportunity
hard.fairness: defer to existing turn order/LOS/movement; no unseen information, clairvoyance or cheating

aiQuality.initiative: unchanged global initiative/speed rules; scaling SPD may influence ordering when initiative uses SPD
aiQuality.tieBreak: deterministic by unit ID / target ID / lexicographically ordered cell after value ties
aiQuality.additionalTargetRules: each 7-mission overlay supplies objective-specific role priorities

structureScaling.normal: only if overlay explicitly specifies HP/DEF, with current % HP carried at start 100%
structureScaling.hard: same, preserving subobjective percentage, no direct facility player healing or extra invulnerability
structureScaling.facilityDamage: use ordinary formula with scaled enemy attack/weapon and overlaid structure DEF

minimumBalancingTestsForLaterImplementat: Each stage viable with three legal builds near lower recommended level, without forced unique rewards from that stage or later.
All 7 objectives and subobjectives are attainable, but a losing line exists under reasonable player mistakes.
Timed objectives meet round limit under at least one legal planned sequence despite enemy AI.
No unreasonable guaranteed party wipe from enemy bonus units at start before any response.
Special attack in Hard M02 clearly telegraphed and avoidable with legal movement.
Revive/respawn never awards extra EXP, bypasses timer or softlocks a mission.
Run bounded deterministic smoke tests first; tune multipliers based on actual gameplay rather than invented win-rate statistics.
unresolved: Exact global turn action/initiative/LOS and movement geometric definitions are not yet fixed.
Balance multipliers and bounded-AI evaluation weights are candidates pending combat-core simulation.
Later M08–30 encounters will use same policy principles but need separate mission-band appropriate scalar calibration.
Whether enemy energy-cost specials outside explicit boss abilities ever appear in later stages is not defined here.
Adoption approves the design baseline but does not prove numerical feasibility, game balance or source Easy candidate approval.

approval.scope: difficulty philosophy and provisional scalar and AI choices
